gaps: No editing tutorial specific to Bihar/Patna weddings (Hindi, Bhojpuri or Maithili) was found. Bihari studios post finished teasers but no how-to content.

No Final Cut Pro tutorial covers the traditional 1-3 hour Indian 'full video' master. Long-form mixing tutorials are all in Edius or Premiere (TqTixDuSQR8), so the FCP version has to be translated from those.

Hindi or India-specific colour grading inside Final Cut Pro is thin. The only direct match (Lakshay Bagga, kbAH5pAr6bc) has about 2k views and was left out, so grading guidance combines Indian studio tutorials (GRY) with Western FCP/Resolve ones.
No tutorial on grading reception halls (mixed LED and stage colours, flash spill) or haldi yellow casts specifically. This must be inferred from general skin-tone and HSL lessons.
No tutorial on mixing live folk geet (women's songs, gaali) with noise reduction under a background bed. The audio-design pick (ibzLEmwFQ5U) is generic highlight sound design.
Mashup tutorials are DJ/performance-oriented (dance medleys). No wedding film editor shows how to cut a mashup to picture, and no candidate covered song licensing/copyright for published films.
The Telugu beat-sync tutorial (-SJRRFQvA54, World Of Kalyan) has good chapters on clip-cutting rules and speed ramps but was left out because its captions are neither Hindi nor English.
Descriptions and chapters could not be checked this run: yt-dlp single-video lookups returned YouTube's bot-check. Picks rest on search metadata (title, channel, views, duration).
